item.title: Aerosol SCP
item.content:encoded:
Seeking green light: Yes

Page type: SCP Article

Page layout: Standard SCP format with several addendums and a link to an offset page.

Elevator pitch: The SCP is an anomalous aerosol created by the Manna Charitable Foundation with the intention of reducing the Earth's temperature to halt or reduce global warming by reflecting the Sun's rays using anomalously enhanced sulfur dioxide which are designed to last longer and grow even larger by abosrbing Co2 in the atmosphere. The conprocs for the first iteration states that its currently uncontained and personal assigned are to work on either containing it or lessen its negative effects, as well as preventing the public from learning its anomalous effects.

In the second iteration, the conprocs states its the cause of an active GK-Class "Ozone destruction" scenario and while they are working on to stop by spreading alkaline all across the atmosphere, their unsure if it'll work or not due to the magnitude of the SCP.

Central narrative: A long time ago, the MCF was working on Project Sunna to try and fix global warming as its directly/indirectly responsible for a lot of bad things happening in the world, with funding from not only some governments but also anomaloud GoIs. Its the biggest project MCF has created.

They then released it via planes into the atmosphere which worked for a while; however, as years gone by, the ozone became severely damaged in some parts of the world to the point where thousands are dying. As the SCP Foundation is trying to stop it, the MCF however have fallen and received a shit ton of backlash for this.

Hook: While it maybe another one of those MCF articles where they try to do good things, only to end in disaster this one however takes it to another, global scale where the MCF really fucked up.

Notes: I need someone to help fact check these things to make sure if at least some of it correct.
